THE NATURAL HISTORY OF NORWAY
Erich Pontoppidan (Erik Ludvigsen Pontoppidan, 1698-1764), Bishop of Bergen
Translated from the Danish by Andreas Berthelson
London: A. Linde, 1755. Two parts in one volume.
========================================================================
PROVENANCE NOTE (Tower of Babel staging): First and only English translation of
"Forsog til Norges naturlige historie" (Copenhagen, 1752-1753). Public domain
scan (Smithsonian Institution Libraries / Internet Archive). The work is complete:
Part I (206 pp.) and Part II (291 pp.), with index and errata (including the
famous erratum "for Kraken read Sea Snake"). The sea-serpent, kraken and mermaid
accounts are in Part II, Chapter VIII. Period typography preserved (long s
rendered as f in the OCR).
